---
title: "MatrixDecomp — single-condition pipeline"
jupyter: python3
---

Runs the full pipeline for the single-view supervised factor model on one
simulated dataset: load → process → train → local inference → prediction →
evaluation → factor interpretation. Every step goes through the helpers in
`python/run_methods.py` (with `model_type="single_view"`) and
`python/factor_interpretation.py`.

- Sweeps over replicates and conditions: `python/matrixdecomp_hyperparam_run.py`
- Experiments (PVE attribution, shrinkage diagnostics): `sim/exploration/`
- The previous version of this notebook: `sim/archive/python_factorization_2026-06.qmd`

## Setup

```{python}
import os
import sys
import importlib

os.environ["R_HOME"] = "/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources"
sys.path.insert(1, "/Users/jonathanhori/multiomic_integration/python")

# Pick up edits to the helper modules without restarting the kernel.
for _mod in ("matrix_decomp", "run_methods", "handler", "data_utils",
             "constants", "factor_interpretation"):
    if _mod in sys.modules:
        importlib.reload(sys.modules[_mod])

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import pyro
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from run_methods import (
    load_rds, process_data, train_model, train_model_locally, evaluate_fitted_model,
)
from factor_interpretation import (
    summarize_factors, plot_pve, plot_r2, plot_factor_loadings,
    plot_factor_scores_2d, plot_factor_outcome, tabulate_top_features,
)
from constants import Sites
```

## Settings

All choices for this run live in this cell.

```{python}
MODEL_TYPE = "single_view"
DATA_ROOT  = "~/multiomic_integration/sim/data/single_view/k.5"

rep_config = {
    "n": 500, "p_l": 100, "snr_x": 2, "snr_y": 2,
    "rep": 1, "sparsity": 0.25, "k_delta": 10,
}

# False: use the separate simulated test set. True: split the training file 80/20.
TRAINING_SPLIT = False

DEVICE              = torch.device("cpu")
N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES = 500
SVD_INIT            = False
FIG_DIR             = None     # set to a folder path to save interpretation figures

train_config = {
    "eta":                   1.0,
    "delta":                 1e-16,
    "t":                     0.1,
    "num_particles":         2,
    "minibatch_size":        32,
    "min_epochs":            200,
    "max_epochs":            1000,
    "convergence_criterion": "elbo_snr",
    "snr_threshold":         1,
}
# Local inference has used the default stopping rule (elbo_min) for this model.
local_config = {**train_config, "convergence_criterion": "elbo_min"}
```

## Load data

```{python}
cond_dir = (f"n{rep_config['n']}p{rep_config['p_l']}"
            f"_snr{rep_config['snr_x']}.{rep_config['snr_y']}"
            f"_sparse{rep_config['sparsity']}")

def rds_path(split):
    return os.path.expanduser(f"{DATA_ROOT}/{split}/{cond_dir}/"
                              f"sim_data_rep{rep_config['rep']}.rds")

print("Loading:", rds_path("train"))
sim_data      = load_rds(rds_path("train"))
sim_data_test = None if TRAINING_SPLIT else load_rds(rds_path("test"))

print("K =", int(sim_data["K"]),
      " n =", sim_data["X_l"][0].shape[0], " p =", sim_data["X_l"][0].shape[1])
```

## Process data

```{python}
train_subset, test_subset, data_package = process_data(
    sim_data, sim_data_test,
    training_split=TRAINING_SPLIT, training_size=0.8, seed=123,
    model_type=MODEL_TYPE,
)
print("train n:", len(train_subset), " test n:", len(test_subset))
```

## Train

```{python}
K_FIT = int(sim_data["K"]) + rep_config["k_delta"]
model_config = {"k": K_FIT, "dense_model": False}

pyro.clear_param_store()
factor_model, train_handler, global_state = train_model(
    model_config, train_config, train_subset,
    model_type=MODEL_TYPE, write=False, verbose=True,
    device=DEVICE, svd_init=SVD_INIT,
)
print(f"Global training: {factor_model.total_epochs} epochs, "
      f"{global_state['inference_time']:.1f}s")
```

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.5))
axes[0].plot(factor_model.loss_history[1:])
axes[0].set(xlabel="Epoch", ylabel="Negative ELBO", title="Minibatch loss per epoch")
axes[1].plot(factor_model.var_param_convergence_history[1:])
axes[1].set(xlabel="Epoch", ylabel="Norm difference",
            title="Variational parameter change per epoch")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Local inference on the test set

Infers test-set scores from X only, with the global parameters frozen.

```{python}
factor_model, test_handler, local_state = train_model_locally(
    factor_model, local_config, test_subset,
    model_type=MODEL_TYPE, verbose=True, device=DEVICE,
)
print(f"Local inference: {factor_model.local_epochs} epochs, "
      f"{local_state['inference_time']:.1f}s")
```

## Evaluate

```{python}
eval_table, _, post_samples, post_samples_test = evaluate_fitted_model(
    rep_config, data_package, train_handler, test_handler,
    global_state, local_state,
    N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES, model_type=MODEL_TYPE,
)
eval_table
```

## Prediction

Posterior mean prediction against the observed (standardised) outcome.

```{python}
pred_train = post_samples[Sites.y].mean(dim=0).squeeze()
pred_test  = post_samples_test[Sites.y_pred].mean(dim=0).squeeze()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
for ax, pred, true, label in [
    (axes[0], pred_train, data_package["train_y_clean"].squeeze(), "Train"),
    (axes[1], pred_test,  data_package["test_y_clean"].squeeze(),  "Test"),
]:
    sns.regplot(x=pred.numpy(), y=true.numpy(), ax=ax, scatter_kws={"alpha": 0.6})
    ax.axline((0, 0), slope=1, color="black", ls="--")
    ax.set(xlabel="Predicted y", ylabel="Simulated y", title=f"Outcome predictions — {label}")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Factor interpretation

Posterior means of the scores, loadings and outcome effects on the training set.

```{python}
X_list_interp      = data_package["train_X_l_list_clean"]
Z_interp           = post_samples[Sites.Z].mean(dim=0)
Lambda_list_interp = [post_samples[Sites.Lambda_l.format(l=0)].mean(dim=0).squeeze()]
beta_interp        = post_samples[Sites.beta].mean(dim=0).squeeze()
y_interp           = data_package["train_y_clean"].squeeze()

def fig_path(name):
    return os.path.join(FIG_DIR, name) if FIG_DIR else None
```

### Factor summary

```{python}
factor_summary = summarize_factors(
    X_list=X_list_interp, Z=Z_interp, Lambda_list=Lambda_list_interp,
    beta=beta_interp, y=y_interp, beta_samples=post_samples[Sites.beta],
    plot=True, verbose=True,
)
R_varimax   = factor_summary["R"]
top_factors = (factor_summary["post"]["per_factor"]["factor"].values - 1).tolist()
```

### Proportion of variance explained

```{python}
pve = plot_pve(Lambda_list_interp, title="PVE per factor — MatrixDecomp (unrotated)")
pve_rot = plot_pve(Lambda_list_interp, rotate=True,
                   title="PVE per factor — MatrixDecomp (varimax-rotated)")
```

### R² per factor

```{python}
r2 = plot_r2(X_list_interp, Z_interp, Lambda_list_interp,
             title="R² per factor — MatrixDecomp")
```

### Loadings

```{python}
Lambda_rot_list = plot_factor_loadings(
    Lambda_list_interp, rotate=True,
    title="Factor loadings — MatrixDecomp (varimax-rotated)",
    save_path=fig_path("loadings.png"),
)
```

### Scores

```{python}
plot_factor_scores_2d(
    Z_interp, y=y_interp, top_factors=top_factors, n_factors=5,
    y_label="Outcome", title="Factor scores for top active factors",
    save_path=fig_path("scores.png"),
)
```

```{python}
plot_factor_outcome(
    factor_summary["Z_rot"], y_interp, top_factors=top_factors, n_factors_show=6,
    outcome_label="Outcome", title="Outcome versus score for top active factors",
    factor_summary=factor_summary, save_path=fig_path("scores_vs_outcome.png"),
)
```

### Outcome effects before and after rotation

```{python}
beta_np = beta_interp.double().numpy()
est_betas = pd.DataFrame({
    "beta":     beta_np,
    "beta_rot": R_varimax.T @ beta_np,
    "factor":   range(len(beta_np)),
}).melt(id_vars=["factor"], var_name="type")

g = sns.catplot(data=est_betas, kind="bar", x="factor", y="value", hue="type")
g.fig.suptitle("Posterior mean beta_k before and after varimax rotation")
plt.show()
```

### Top features per factor

```{python}
top_feature_tables = tabulate_top_features(
    Lambda_list_interp, n_top_factors=min(8, K_FIT), n_top_features=10, rotate=True,
)
display(top_feature_tables[0])
```
